title: fix(lint)!: a body whose regular-expression pattern the runtime's QuickJS also refuses is refused, not only warned about
body:
Fixes #35694

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #36727

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在动作、钩子、定时任务的脚本里写错正则(比如括号没闭合)时,校验和发布现在直接报错拦下,不再只给一个警告;两种运行时其实能跑的写法仍只是警告。
- 为什么做:这类脚本以前能通过校验和发布,上线后每次运行都失败;本单同时收掉并入的两条后续(钩子与定时任务编译失败的提示语、校验说明的几处措辞)。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个本来能运行的正则被误拦,作者改写正则即可;可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

One PR for the fold group on this card: its own ask, row #35715 (runtime: a hook or job body that fails to compile) and row #35720 (review follow-ups N1 to N5 of the hook/job compile check). Rows are named here, not closed: both are already closed as cards.

**The card's ask: a regular-expression pattern QuickJS also refuses is refused at `error`** (`packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`). Mechanism: an allow-list of V8 pattern REASONs. V8 words a pattern failure `Invalid regular expression: /PATTERN/FLAGS: REASON`; `judgeBodyCompile` now reads the REASON (the text after the last colon-space) and sends only `Duplicate capture group name` and `Invalid group` (the two measured dialect gaps) to the `warning` arm, new shape `regexp-dialect-gap`. A third measured gap is judged per name, not per reason: on `Invalid property name` (and `… in character class`) the rule compiles each `\p{BODY}` of the pattern alone and sends the pattern to the `warning` arm only when every name this host refuses is on a measured list of twelve spellings QuickJS knows and V8 does not (`REGEXP_PROPERTY_NAMES_ONLY_QUICKJS_KNOWS`, measurement below), so `\p{Nope}` stays an `error` and `\p{IDSU}` is a `warning`. On a host whose Unicode tables are older than the 17.0 tables the list was measured on, every property-name refusal is a `warning` (the list says nothing about such a host). Every other REASON is shape `regexp-pattern` at `error`, with a hint that names the fix. The allow-list is the narrow side: a reason it does not name is an error, so a later V8 that accepts more only removes findings. A non-V8 host (the `Function` fallback) words its sentences differently and none of them reads as a pattern reason, so every failure there is an error, as before. Because all three rules read the one `judgeBodyCompile`, the same split reaches `hook-body-does-not-compile` and `job-body-does-not-compile`.

The measurement it rests on: the same wrapper text compiled by Node 22's V8 (12.4, `node:vm` `Script`) and by quickjs-emscripten 0.32.0 (`newQuickJSWASMModule`, `evalCode`), 37 patterns.

<details><summary>Probe table: V8 reason · QuickJS answer</summary>

| pattern | V8 (Node 22.23.5) | QuickJS 0.32.0 | rule now |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| unterminated group `/(/`, `/(?:/` | Unterminated group | expecting ')' | error |
| nothing to repeat `a**` | Nothing to repeat | nothing to repeat | error |
| class range `/[b-a]/` | Range out of order in character class | invalid class range | error |
| dangling named back-reference under `u` (backslash-k naming group x, none declared) | Invalid named capture referenced | group name not defined | error |
| `/\p{Nope}/u` | Invalid property name | unknown unicode property name | error |
| `/\p{IDSU}/u`, `/[\p{MCM}]/v`, `/\p{sc=Hrkt}/u` and the nine other measured spellings | Invalid property name | **compiles** | warning |
| `/a{/u` | Incomplete quantifier | invalid repetition count | error |
| `/)/` | Unmatched ')' | extraneous characters at the end | error |
| `/a{2,1}/` | numbers out of order in {} quantifier | invalid repetition count | error |
| `/\u{110000}/u`, `/\c/u` | Invalid Unicode escape | invalid escape sequence | error |
| a capture group named `1a` | Invalid capture group name | invalid group name | error |
| `/[\d-z]/u` | Invalid character class | invalid class range | error |
| `/\-/u`, `/\2(a)/u` | Invalid escape | invalid escape / back reference out of range | error |
| a lookbehind or lookahead quantified under `u` | Invalid quantifier | nothing to repeat | error |
| duplicate named group in different alternatives (two groups named a, joined by a bar), also under `u` | Duplicate capture group name | **compiles** | warning |
| modifier groups `(?i:a)`, `(?-i:a)`, `(?i-m:a)`, `(?ims:a)`, also under `u` | Invalid group | **compiles** | warning |
| duplicate named group in ONE alternative | Duplicate capture group name | duplicate group name | warning (residual) |
| `(?ii:a)`, `(?i-i:a)`, `(?-:a)`, `(?x:a)`, `(?x)`, `(?`, unterminated `(?i:` | Invalid group | refused | warning (residual) |
| a dialect-gap construct first, then a second error (`(`, `[b-a]`, an unknown property) | the gap's reason (V8 names only the first) | refused | warning (residual) |

</details>

**The property-name measurement** (review S1: V8's `Invalid property name` is a third place where the host refuses and QuickJS runs).

- Candidate set: every identifier in the property tables of quickjs-emscripten 0.32.0's release-sync wasm (the NUL-separated, comma-split name strings), 2,909 names. These tables are QuickJS's whole vocabulary: a name not in them QuickJS refuses, so the list below is complete for the measured host.
- Forms: each name bare and after `gc=`, `General_Category=`, `sc=`, `Script=`, `scx=`, `Script_Extensions=`; flags `u` and `v`; the escape bare and inside a class. 81,452 literals.
- Both engines, same wrapper text, `(async (input, ctx) => { return LITERAL;` newline `})`: V8 through `node:vm` `Script` on Node 22.23.5 (V8 12.4.254.21, ICU 78.3, Unicode 17.0), QuickJS through `newQuickJSWASMModule` and `evalCode`.
- Result: 48 disagreements, every one "V8 refuses, QuickJS compiles", none the other way. They are twelve body spellings across the four flag/context variants: `IDS_Unary_Operator`, `IDSU`, `Modifier_Combining_Mark`, `MCM`, and `Katakana_Or_Hiragana` / `Hrkt` after each of `sc=`, `Script=`, `scx=`, `Script_Extensions=`.
- Not measured: a host with older tables (an early Node 22 ships Unicode 15.1). Downloading such a Node was refused in this container, so the rule makes no claim there and warns on every property-name refusal on such a host.

The residual rows are the allow-list's measured cost: the two allow-listed reasons are wider than the two constructs, and V8 names only the first failure, so those patterns stay a `warning` although QuickJS refuses them. That is a refusal missed, never a body that runs refused; judging them would mean a second regular-expression grammar in this rule. The module note records the whole table.

**N1** (riding nit): the two "still only warns" pins read whether THIS host refuses the pattern (`new RegExp`), and on Node 22 or older they first require that it does, so they are not weakened on `.nvmrc`'s Node 22 and stay green on a later Node that accepts the constructs (no finding). **N2**: the `os explain` paragraphs now qualify the two pattern differences as measured against Node 22's V8. **N4**: the unterminated-literal hint and the `replacement` of `action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused` name a line terminator inside the literal (a single-backslash `\n` in a quoted or JSON-carried `body.source`).

**Row #35715** (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`): `actionBodyCompileFailure` becomes `bodyCompileFailure(origin, …)` and is reached for every body kind, so a hook or job body that does not compile reads `hook 'NAME' does not compile: SyntaxError: …` (`job 'NAME' …`), not the `threw` sentence of a body that ran and threw. The action's answer is byte-identical. A hook's and a job's keep the compiler's own text in `innerMessage` and declare no status: measured, a declared `500` makes the `/data` door answer `{ error: 'Internal server error' }` WITHOUT its `INTERNAL_ERROR` code, and no door that answers a hook relays a server-band sentence, so the caller's answer stays the sanitised `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` it was (pinned equal to a body that ran and threw).

**Row #35720**: N1 corrects the `suppressWarnings` note in `validate-hook-body-compiles.ts` (no per-rule suppression exists; `os explain` and the finding's `rule` field carry the two ids). N2 narrows "no door publishes a job" in `authoring-rules.ts` and in `hook-job-body-does-not-compile-refused` to the metadata publish door, naming the boot and `os package install`. N3: a hook lowered from an inline `handler` gets a hint naming the handler, not `body.source`. N4: the runtime pins above run the two pinned bodies (`const ctx = ctx.input || {}`, `let x = 1; let x = 2;`) in QuickJS inside the `(ctx)` wrapper, for a hook and a job. N5: `action-body-wrapper.ts` records why the parse checks' `async function __body(ctx)` is a parse enclosure and not a second spelling of a run wrapper, and the four comments that still described the hook wrapper as the AsyncFunction constructor now name the arrow wrapper.

ADR-0087: new semantic entry `body-regexp-pattern-refused` (D3, no conversion); the three sibling entries' text now says which pattern failures warn. `BodyCompileShape` gains `regexp-dialect-gap`.

Files outside the claim's file surface, each text-only, each because this diff made its sentence false or the fold row names it: `packages/lint/src/validate-hook-body-writes.ts` and its test, `packages/lint/src/checked-parse.ts` (N5 comments); `packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts` (N5, TSDoc); `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-body-does-not-compile-refused.ts` (its `replacement` said every pattern failure warns); `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` (two sentences said the same). Round 1 also touches, text only, `18.action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused.ts` and `18.hook-job-body-does-not-compile-refused.ts` (their warning arm now names the property-name gap); the seat amended the claim's file surface to cover these paths. `hook-bodies.mdx` now also names a job's sentence, `job 'NAME' does not compile: …` (seat nit).

## Read first

1. `packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts` — `REGEXP_DIALECT_GAP_REASONS`, `REGEXP_PROPERTY_NAMES_ONLY_QUICKJS_KNOWS`, `onlyQuickJsKnowsTheRefusedProperty` (reads the pattern back from V8's sentence and compiles each property escape alone) and `isRegexpDialectGap`: the whole behaviour change.
2. `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` — `bodyCompileFailure`: the action branch must stay byte-identical, the hook/job branch must leave the door answer alone.
3. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.body-regexp-pattern-refused.ts` — the ledger entry the narrowing ships with.

## Two-minute check

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts` — expect every case green, among them six `refuses … at error: the runtime's engine refuses the pattern too` rows, two `still only warns on …` rows and twelve `only warns on the property NAME …` rows.

## Tests

Round 1 (review S1) is on head `6b0b9b3a8f`; the code it adds is `packages/lint` only, plus text in `packages/spec` migration entries, the changeset and `content/docs`.

- `@objectstack/lint` full suite on `6b0b9b3a8f`: Test Files 227 passed (227), Tests 9489 passed (9489) (round 0: 9476; the thirteen new cases are the twelve measured spellings, each as `/\p{NAME}/u` and `/[\P{NAME}a]/v`, plus the `\p{IDSU}\p{Nope}` pin that a known-to-QuickJS name beside an unknown one stays an error); `typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/spec` `build` exit 0 and `--project local src/migrations`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 200 passed (200).
- `@objectstack/cli` `test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`: 3 passed.
- Unchanged since round 0 and not rerun locally: `@objectstack/runtime` (round 1 does not touch it; round 0 on `81c369ca5`: Test Files 640 passed, Tests 11850 passed, 25 skipped), the core census test (49 passed), the full `@objectstack/spec` suite (Test Files 880, Tests 28058). CI on `6b0b9b3a8f` ran all of them: Test Core and its ten shards succeeded.
- Full dogfood (`(narrowing)` arm), once, on `6b0b9b3a8f`: Test Files 487 passed, 3 skipped (490); Tests 4121 passed, 68 skipped (4189); lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The first attempt was killed by a container restart (exit 137) and rerun whole.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

1. Lint judge (round 0): the shape ternary `REGEXP_DIALECT_GAP_REASONS.includes(reason) ? 'regexp-dialect-gap' : 'regexp-pattern'` replaced by a constant `'regexp-dialect-gap'`. The first attempt used a replacement the anchor already contained, and the tool refused it as not landed ("the replacement count moved 5 -> 5"), so that run measured nothing; rerun with a marked replacement: anchor 1 -> 0, blob a5f76b204ad0 -> 0311ac90d158, 9 failed / 35 passed (the six classes, the unterminated-group pin, the os validate and publish-door pin, the hook/job split pin). Restored: blob == HEAD a5f76b204ad0.
2. Runner (round 0): `if (isCompileFailure(err))` replaced by the old action-only guard. Anchor 1 -> 0, blob 61b0aae79ad6 -> 270bf32f548b, 4 failed / 12 passed (the four hook/job compile-failure rows). Restored: blob == HEAD 61b0aae79ad6.
3. Property-name exception (round 1, on `6b0b9b3a8f`): the property arm of `isRegexpDialectGap`, `return REGEXP_PROPERTY_REASONS.includes(reason) && onlyQuickJsKnowsTheRefusedProperty(error, reason);`, replaced by `return false;` (so every property-name refusal is an error again). Anchor 1 -> 0, blob 12f040bdd087 -> 7e981385e82a, 12 failed / 33 passed (the twelve `only warns on the property NAME` rows; the six-class `\p{Nope}` row and the `\p{IDSU}\p{Nope}` pin stay green, as expected). Restored: blob == HEAD 12f040bdd087.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The allow-list misses some refusals, on purpose and measured** (the residual rows of the probe table): a pattern whose first V8 reason is `Duplicate capture group name` or `Invalid group` stays a warning even where QuickJS refuses it. Closing that would take a second regular-expression grammar in the rule.
- **A host with Unicode tables older than 17.0 is not measured.** The twelve-name list was measured on Unicode 17.0 tables; an early Node 22 ships 15.1, where V8 may refuse further names QuickJS knows. Rather than guess, the rule warns on every property-name refusal on such a host (a refusal missed there, never a body that runs refused). A Node 22.0.0 download to measure it was refused in this container.
- **Not V8**: under the `Function` fallback (a page) no sentence is read as a pattern reason, so every regular-expression failure there is an error, as every other failure already was.
- **A hook's or a job's caller answer is unchanged.** Measured on this tree: a declared `500` with a caller sentence makes `mapDataError` answer `{ error: 'Internal server error' }` without its `INTERNAL_ERROR` code, so the hook/job branch keeps the native text and no status. The `/data` door dropping the code for a code-less declared 5xx is pre-existing and not changed here.
- **The two sibling changesets** `.changeset/35040-action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused.md` and `.changeset/34987-hook-job-body-does-not-compile.md` (both unreleased) still say a pattern failure is a warning. They are left as written, not edited: this PR's changeset, released with them, states the narrowing.
- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts` still names `actionBodyCompileFailure` in a comment beside the `actionName` sample, which the census no longer reads. Stale comment only, out of this surface.
- `hook-refusal-catalogue.ts` comments say "an action body that does not compile" passes by identity, which stays true (only the action's is a runner-own fault).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` first exited 3 (client dists not built). Rerun after the closure build: exit 0, 349 prose examples type-check.

</details>

The other families exited 0, among them `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes` and the docs families the `content/docs` edit adds.
